Saudi Electricity Bill Table by Consumption

Find your monthly consumption to see your bill before and after the change. For a larger breaker or an exact figure, use the calculator.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

The table is calculated with the same formula as the Saudi electricity bill calculator: 21 halalas per kWh up to 6,000 and 33 halalas above, a fixed fee of SAR 70 for a breaker under 100 A, then 15% VAT.

Three things the table shows

  1. The increase is 3 halalas per kWh in both tiers, or SAR 34.50 per 1,000 kWh including VAT.
  2. The fixed fee adds SAR 80.50 including VAT for a breaker under 100 A, replacing the current meter fees.
  3. Consumption above 6,000 kWh is charged at 33 halalas, so cutting it saves the most.

Frequently asked questions

What is the new electricity bill for 1,000 kWh?

SAR 322 including VAT for a breaker under 100 A: SAR 210 for consumption (21 halalas) and 70 in fixed fees, plus 15% VAT. At the current tariff it was SAR 207, without meter fees.

What is the bill for 3,000 kWh at the new tariff?

SAR 805 including VAT: SAR 630 for consumption and 70 in fixed fees, plus VAT. It was SAR 621 at the current tariff, without meter fees.

Does the current tariff in the table include meter fees?

No, because the meter reading and maintenance fees on the current bill are not published in detail, so the actual difference may be slightly smaller than shown.
